structural_breaks.note: Acquisition of Power Engineering Transformatory Sp. z o.o. (PET, Czerwonak/Poznań, Poland) in 2017 → consolidated group reporting starts with H1-2017 (quarter columns from Q3-2017; Q2-2017 only as the comparative printed in the H1-2018 group report). FY2018Q1 comparative printed by the company is the parent-only Q1-2017.
Control of Novi Feromont d.o.o. (Donji Kraljevec) acquired end-2025; P&L consolidated from 1-Jan-2026. Ferokotao stake raised from 51% to 82.5% (Feb/Apr 2026).

profile.products: Pure-play transformer maker: medium-power transformers and autotransformers up to 160 MVA / 170 kV (outdoor/indoor); oil-immersed distribution transformers 50 kVA–8 MVA up to 36 kV; dry-type distribution transformers 50–5,000 kVA; special transformers & MV reactors (offshore wind, grounding, rectifier, auxiliary, generator step-up, traction, mobile-substation, test-station). >10,000 units per year to >110 countries. Subsidiaries: PET (Poland, transformers), Ferokotao & Novi Feromont (transformer tanks/metal structures).

plants.products: distribution, medium-power and special transformers; new factory planned in Zaprešić (largest capacity expansion in group history)
Power Engineering Transformatory — transformers; new hall + test lab under construction (2026)
Ferokotao d.o.o. and Novi Feromont d.o.o. — transformer tanks / metal structures

profile.end_markets: EU distribution utilities, wind/solar and BESS grid connections, industry, e-mobility; export share ≈93% of H1-2026 consolidated sales (288.7 of 309.3 EUR m). Backlog EUR 1,090.5m at 30-Jun-2026 (book-to-bill 1.30 in H1-2026).

proxy_routes.why: Croatian exports of 650 kVA–10 MVA liquid transformers — D&ST's core distribution/medium units; D&ST is the dominant Croatian exporter in this band
Croatian exports >10 MVA — D&ST medium-power (up to 160 MVA) plus the Siemens Energy JV's large units (noise)
Croatian exports of dry-type transformers >500 kVA (D&ST dry-type)
Croatian C27.1 production index (transformers & distribution apparatus)
German C27.1 production — proxy for the German/Central-European distribution-grid investment cycle that D&ST exports into
Austrian C27.1 production — Austria is a key D&ST export market (company award as best exporter to Austria)
Eurostat Comext monthly EU imports of HS 850421-850423 from Croatia — closest external mirror of D&ST shipments
